text_block_list.text:
Under the blazing sun, DREAMS took on 
their summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: On your mark. Get set,

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Go!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Oooorrrryaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"An ordeal... this blazing sun is an 
ordeal as well... If possible, I would 
prefer summers in 'that land' to be just a 
bit more comfortable, though..."

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, the sun's really beating down out 
there. Splitting training between morning 
and evening was definitely the right call, 
huh?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's take a break soon, then.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I'm crossing this ocean to go 
to America, aren't I? To deliver love to 
the world♡

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, totally. But I wonder what it's 
really like? I could tell just by watching 
that everyone was great at managing their 
race, though."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The BC is the final ordeal for the 
Saintess journeying to 'that sacred land.' 
Surely the other runners are magical 
Umamusume or mythical beast Umamusume in 
disguise――"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Just what kinda America are you 
imagining...? But man, their power in a 
scramble must be crazy strong too.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well, they are world-class, after 
all. Though they're a bit different from 
the 'monster' Desire-san was talking 
about.
choice_data_list:
W-Well, it's only natural you can't tell 
just by imagining it.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
You can't really tell just by imagining 
it... Hmm... Well, I guess that makes 
sense.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey. I wanna drink some Hachimi~ The 
kind they sell at the beach hut.
choice_data_list: Hachimi? Alright, I'll go buy some.
Hachimi? Alright, I'll go buy some.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds good. Then Trainer and I will 
go buy it. ...Everyone else, please rest 
in the shade first.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. I'll take the one with lemon.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I'll have a rich berry mix, then.
choice_data_list:
The one with lemon and the rich berry mix, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, then I'll have the Special Hojicha 
Latte♪

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Okaaay, Maru-chan will have the same one 
as Love-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Alright, then I'll――

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"One 'Vanilla Cream Extra White Mocha 
Fresh Berry & Passion Fruit Hachimi Blue 
Ocean Style', please."

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, it's a limited-edition summer 
item. We're heading over to the rocky 
shore, so catch ya later!☆"

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Two 'Vanilla Cream Extra White Mocha 
Fresh Berry & Passion Fruit Hachimi Blue 
Ocean Style', please~!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Oh…… Everyone really is ordering that one 
with the long name."

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Alright, next customer~.
choice_data_list: Vanilla cream extra... what was it again

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"A 'Vanilla Cream Extra White Mocha Fresh 
Berry & Passion Fruit Hachimi Blue Ocean 
Style', please."
choice_data_list:
I don't think I could ever memorize this 
in a lifetime...!

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Here it is~♪ I've been looking forward to 
this~. I practically took this long trip 
just for it, really♪

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? At first glance, it doesn't look 
quite as flashy as the name suggests...?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, here it is～♪ I've been waiting for 
this☆

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, from the name alone I 
thought it was one of those trendy 
'Instagrammable' items, but... contrary to 
expectations, it has a rather subdued 
appearance, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, figures☆ Oh, would you like a bite?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. Excuse me, then—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Gah!? Th-This sensation spreading 
throughout my mouth is...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
A resort... Yes, a beautiful resort sea! 
The harmony played by the ingredients 
makes me see the ocean!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
So this is truly what is meant by "a Blue 
Ocean tailoring"...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Such exquisite deliciousness.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It truly felt like a "beautiful 
ocean," living up to its "Blue Ocean 
Tailored" name.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Fufun♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, it wasn't what you expected, 
right? That Hachimii.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. Normally you'd totally think 
it was an 'Insta-worthy' kind of thing.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
And then, you see it with your own eyes 
and taste it. That's when you finally 
understand the meaning behind the name.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you know, I don't think this 
kind of thing is just limited to sweets, 
personally.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
You can't see the true nature of your 
opponent with just bits and pieces of info 
you heard around.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...I see. You're talking about our 
speculation regarding BC.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Yep. We still don't fully get what the BC 
is all about. So let's learn more about 
it♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"As long as your research is solid, you 
can create a roadmap toward any goal, 
right? ♪"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, since that's how it is—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Sent... and done.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
That's・it. A proposal, they call it. Just 
something simple I whipped up real quick.
choice_data_list: The 'Let's Go Watch the BC Live☆' plan...?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...? This is...! All of "DREAMS" going for 
an on-site inspection of the BC...?!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ Half the battle is decided by the 
accuracy of your info! So this scouting 
mission is top priority for us right now☆

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Of course, travel expenses will be pretty 
steep... but there'll definitely be 
medium-to-long-term returns, right? Come 
on♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Waah! Does that mean we can go to America 
before the real race?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Is a Special Project 'BC Tour' on the 
Horizon~!?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
At last... to "that place"...! Fufu... 
well, our true "arrival" won't be until 
next year, though.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh! If it comes down to it, I could even 
pick a fight right then and there with 
whoever wins this year, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Let's go watch it! The true 
essence of being the world's strongest! 
For us, that's—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"I'll take a 'Vanilla Cream Extra White 
Mocha Fresh Berry & Passion Fruit Hachimi 
Blue Ocean Style'!"

"Seeing is believing. Ahead of next year's 
main event, talks of an on-site inspection 
for the Breeders' Cup suddenly emerged."
